title: Ally keep attacking even after enemy died

posts.author: Vyndicate
posts.body:
So I made an assist feature using force action. Assist will active when it reach turn limit (Increase assist turn every ally action), and do action on next turn. But turns out, after all enemy died, the ally keep attacking before victory phase
I also trying to use BattleManager.processVictory(), but got issue on next battle, the troop event doesn't run properly
How to solve this problem

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Can you just put a conditional to the assist that $gameTroop.aliveMembers().length > 0

posts.author: Vyndicate
posts.body:
rpgLord69 said:

Click to expand...
That's what I did too when trying to use BattleManager.processVictory() with something like this in skill notetag
<finish action>
if ($gameTroop.aliveMembers().length == 0)
eval: BattleManager.processVictory()
end
</finish action>
But this cause broken on next battle, which is doesn't run troop event with this condition
I also made a custom function that contains processVictory() and updateBattleEnd(), but still doesn't work properly

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Why try and change the functions? Can't you just put a conditional on your assist mechanic? It's best if you show people how you did your assist.

oh yeah I forgot about that
Here's how the assist work:
Add state and run the script inside notetag for every ally action
After that, it will check on every actor that do the assist
Each common event has their own moves (Different turn limit, different skill usage)
There's also initialize before battle begin using common event
After reach threshold (In this case, Schumaker has 2 turn to trigger), it will trigger the assist
Here's the skill in skill tab. I was adding the finish action but messed up when doing another battle in next one (Won't trigger the troop event)
Edit:
I was changing from Action Start to Action End and it works fine now to prevent redundant attack
Sorry to bother before. It seems the issue is in myself . It's quite clear now
